library.name: Precision Lance
library.response: Keep moving: it is aimed where you are going, so change direction or jump as the line locks.
library.counters: One narrow projectile; a change of direction after the line locks makes it miss. Punishes standing still and slow recovery.

library.name: Converging Volley
library.response: They all meet at the marked point: leave it — sideways, or jump over the meeting point.
library.counters: All six converge on one point chosen when they launch; anywhere outside the mark is safe.

library.name: Heavy Orb
library.response: Slow and huge: keep the drawn burst circle off you — walk away from it, or get past it.
library.counters: It moves at a third of your speed; it bursts only when within 90 px of you.

library.name: Watching Shard
library.response: While the shard watches, attacking or casting releases it at you — wait it out (5 s), or attack and dodge at once.
library.counters: It only reacts to you attacking or casting (the same thing a forge spell can see), and it flies straight at where you are then.

library.name: Delayed Crossfire
library.response: Three shots on three fuses: dodge each as its fuse runs out — dodging only the first is not enough.
library.counters: Each spike is aimed when its own fuse ends; a change of direction between fuses beats the next one.

library.name: Saturation Stream
library.response: The stream follows you slowly: keep running one way, or cut back through behind it.
library.counters: Its aim lags (it sweeps toward you); a steady run outpaces it. Long range only.

library.name: Branching Pursuit
library.response: Two arrows covering two escapes: the first where you are heading, the second where you tend to dodge to. Break your habit.
library.counters: The second branch reads your usual dodge (toward / away / up). Do something else, or stand your ground between them.

library.name: Expanding Burst
library.response: Get out of the drawn ring before it fills (about 1.1 s from the first glow).
library.counters: Only reaches the ring; he is rooted while it builds, so it is also an opening from outside the ring.

library.name: Gilded Ward
library.response: Back off from the ring of motes before it bursts; his guard only blunts damage, so keep attacking from range.
library.counters: The motes burst at 3.5 s around him; the reinforcement lowers damage, it does not stop it.

library.name: Lattice of Mines
library.response: Mines settle in a line: stay in the lanes between them; do not walk into the drawn circles.
library.counters: They only burst when you come within 110 px; lanes of ≈ 100 px between bursts are always safe.

library.name: Absolute Output
library.response: A long, loud wind-up: when the sphere splits, sidestep the lance, slip between the ring shards and outrun the slow core.
library.counters: Everything leaves from one point over his head after a 1.4 s hold; he is rooted for all of it — the best opening to punish.

library.name: Blooming Line
library.response: Five small discs in a line that swell into wide bursts when they reach you: get out of the drawn bloom circles — sideways, or over the line.
library.counters: Each disc only blooms within 110 px of you; the circles drawn round each disc are the real burst size.

library.name: Waiting Mines
library.response: Three mines settle where you were heading and wait: change course, and never run back through them.
library.counters: They only burst within 120 px; a change of direction before they land leaves them behind you.
